execution_protocol.inflight_policy: finish requests admitted before cutoff; refuse later and stale-lease requests
execution_protocol.grading_state: pause simulation ticks after drain; resume before next preparation
execution_protocol.agent_budget: upstream max_iterations=150; recursion_limit=450; not a hard tool budget
